description: This file defines a Roslyn analyzer class 'GrainInterfaceMethodReturnTypeDiagnosticAnalyzer' that enforces rules on the return types of methods in interfaces implementing 'Orleans.Runtime.IAddressable'. It checks that methods return supported asynchronous or void types, and reports diagnostics if not.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceMethodReturnTypeDiagnosticAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer that enforces return type rules on interface methods in Orleans grain interfaces.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Configures analysis settings and registers syntax node action for method declarations.

methods.name: AnalyzeSyntax
methods.description: Analyzes method declaration syntax nodes to verify return types conform to supported types for Orleans grain interfaces.

methods.name: NamespacesEqual
methods.description: Recursively compares namespace symbols to a string span to determine namespace equality.
